subject: PO stub authorization & itemization remedy: TiltTech onboarding
messages:
From: Eleanor Grant <eleanor@tilttech.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: TiltTech onboarding: initial PO & spend cap request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again — excited to get TiltTech live on Redwood. Attached is our completed onboarding packet and the initial catalog of SKUs we expect to consume in Q1. We discussed a provisional PO to unblock testing and a spend cap of $50,000 for the first 90 days while we ramp.

Quick notes:
- We included a csv of expected line items and month-by-month volume estimates (see attachment).
- Our finance team asked for a PO stub that includes the Procurement Code/SKU mapping so they can map to our ledger.

Attachments: tilttech_onboarding_form.pdf, vendor-ledger-snapshot.csv

Can you confirm the expected lead time for a provisional PO stub and whether Redwood requires any additional vendor docs (W9, cert)?

Best,
Eleanor Grant
Head of Partnerships
TiltTech

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Grant <eleanor@tilttech.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: TiltTech onboarding: initial PO & spend cap request

Hi Eleanor — thanks for the packet and the ledger snapshot. Looping in procurement and vendor-ops to action.

Short answers up front:
- Provisional PO stub: we can provide a provisional stub within 48 business hours once we have a complete SKU-to-procurement-code mapping.
- Required docs: W9 or local tax equivalent + corporate registration. If you prefer, you can upload them to the Drive link we sent.

A couple of issues I noticed in the ledger file that will prevent automated PO issuance:
1) Several line descriptions don’t match Redwood SKU strings (e.g., "session-pack" vs our canonical "session_pack_v2"). That causes the vendor mapping to drop line items in our system.
2) The requested single spend cap of $50,000 needs to be split across two procurement buckets (Cloud Usage vs Marketplace Services) so we can apply different billing codes.
3) No explicit quantity vs unit price in several rows — that blocks line-level validation.

To move fast, please:
- Update the csv to include our canonical SKU names (I’ve attached a small sample mapping in the spreadsheet I’ll send after I confirm internally).
- Confirm whether the $50k should be 40/60 split (Cloud Usage / Marketplace) or provide suggested split.

Next steps:
- I’ll task procurement (Karthik) to prepare a PO stub template for you to fill.
- Monica, can you confirm the provisional spend cap workflow and whether finance needs any temporary coding?

Thanks — aiming to have a stub to you by Wednesday if we get the mapping.

Jasmine Liu
Senior Partner Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: RE: TiltTech onboarding: initial PO & spend cap request (internal)

Jasmine / Monica — quick internal note on approach:

I reviewed the snapshot and flagged the common failure modes. Proposed playbook: 
- Issue provisional PO stub (po_stub_v2.xlsx) with: procurement_code, canonical_sku, qty, unit_price, spend_bucket. Stub will be "provisional" and stamped clearly "Not an invoice".
- Temporarily set spend cap as a budget guard in our billing system using a soft threshold: 90% notify / 100% block to avoid accidental overrun. We can set separate caps per spend_bucket.
- For line mismatches, vendor must provide a signed confirmation mapping vendor SKUs to our canonical SKUs. Until mapping received, we will only provisionally authorize a 20% subset of requested lines to reduce risk.

I attached the provisional stub template and an example of how finance wants the split included. Once vendor returns the completed stub and W9, finance can issue the formal PO number.

Reference: JIRA SUP-3211 opened to track this onboarding. Monica — can you create the temporary bucket (TiltTech-DEV) and set the soft thresholds?

-Karthik
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: po_stub_v2.xlsx)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Subject: PO stub authorization & itemization remedy: TiltTech onboarding

Hi Eleanor — following internal review, please find attached the provisional PO stub (po_stub_v2.xlsx) and a copy of the ledger snapshot annotated with Redwood canonical SKUs. Key points: 

- Provisional authorization: We are issuing a provisional stub to unblock testing. This is not the formal PO number. Formal PO will be issued after finance confirms W9/tax docs and the completed stub.
- Spend cap split: We set a recommended split of 40% Cloud Usage / 60% Marketplace Services per your initial request. If you'd like a different split, reply with the preferred allocation by EOD Tuesday.
- Line item correction: Please update the attached spreadsheet with unit_price and qty for every line and sign the SKU mapping. Per Karthik's note, we will only enable a 20% subset of lines provisionally until mapping is fully signed.
